items.value: NONE on the enclosure path: cap_coefficient.py uses exact rational interval arithmetic with outward rounding to 2^-160. exp(-t) is a fixed-point alternating series with an integer rounding budget, pi comes from Machin's formula, and Phi from a fixed-point series (NOTE.md lines 217-218). Floats appear only in __repr__ (line 71) and in the float controls _Phi_f, _phi_f, float_mc, float_quad2d and float_R (lines 507-717). The corollary's slack factors (NOTE.md lines 77-79, 295-304) divide by [NUM]'s binary64 GH60 values of J_1+J_2, which are quoted from another packet and not computed by this object's code. The reference-kernel corollary's slack factors rest on [NUM]'s binary64 GH60 values (see exact_boundary and layer_a_status); those are quoted comparisons, not enclosures.
